segments.name: powered shell facilities
segments.description: Builds and owns powered shell facilities for hyperscale tenants, leased out with contracted power capacity.
segments.evidence: All of the Company's activities relate to our business of building and owning powered shell facilities.

revenueModel.text: Hyperscale tenants pay lease rental income, expected to be based on reserved power capacity and agreed reliability characteristics.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's single reportable segment is expected to earn substantially all of its revenue from lease rental income from hyperscaler tenants.
